comparison.objective: Counterhold a copper riser, operate a tube cutter until separation, and discard the cut piece; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated cutter orbiting with workpiece stabilization and post-cut handling versus recessed setscrew manipulation, collar tuning, and impact assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Pipe separates at the mark and offcut reaches the scrap bucket versus locked adjustment yielding safe repeatable stopping. No separate specs or cut tolerance is provided.
comparison.reason: Material cutting and separation are not adjustment or energy-absorption commissioning.
